extra.message: SQL Injection in Login — Attacker can bypass authentication and log in as any user, or extract all data from the users table, leading to full compromise of the application's authentication and data confidentiality. [verified: The login endpoint directly interpolates unsanitized user input from request.form into an SQL query string (line 33) with no parameterization or validation, allowing an attacker to inject arbitrary SQL commands. This is reachable and exploitable as demonstrated by classic tautology injection.]

Reflected Cross-Site Scripting in /search — An attacker can execute arbitrary JavaScript in the context of the user's session, potentially stealing cookies, redirecting the user, or performing actions on behalf of the user. [verified: Line 52-53 takes the 'q' parameter from the request and directly interpolates it into an HTML response via an f-string without any escaping or sanitization. No input validation, output encoding, or CSP header is present to prevent script execution.]

Missing Authentication on Dashboard — An unauthenticated attacker can access the dashboard, which may contain sensitive information or functionality intended for authenticated users only. [verified: The /dashboard route at line 44 reads the 'session' cookie but never validates it against any server-side store or checks if the user is authenticated. An attacker can access the dashboard with any cookie value or without one, as there is no authentication gate or session verification.]
